_note: Selector job: decide the report's reading order and overall Place Signature by classifying the evidence_ranking.primary_evidence / .supporting_evidence pattern into one of the categories below, per PROSE_PURPOSE_REVIEW.md's 'Needed synthesis categories' list (modeled directly on products/year_ahead/blocks/plainspeak/forecast_synthesis_blocks.json's agreement-label pattern: convergent / supportive / isolated / ambiguous / contradictory / background -- adapted here to place-centered rather than time-centered evidence). Selection should run AFTER evidence_ranking already exists, never before -- this family interprets the ranking's shape, it does not re-derive primary/supporting status itself. Each category below states its selection signal precisely so a selector can implement it directly from planet_house_changes, relocated_angle_contacts, natal_modifiers, evidence_ranking, purpose_lens, and relationship_to_place without inventing new engine fields. Categories are not mutually exclusive by construction (a report could plausibly match convergent_place_signature and purpose_aligned_signature at once) -- selector logic should pick the single best-fit category using an explicit priority order it owns, not expect the evidence record to pre-rank the categories. claim_level 'bounded_interpretation' throughout; every leaf must preserve the same boundary as every other Location Services family: name the mechanism, translate to lived language, state what it does not guarantee -- see PROSE_GUIDE.md. This file must not force every destination into a dramatic story (PROSE_PURPOSE_REVIEW.md's explicit warning) -- quiet_continuity_signature and low_signal_signature exist specifically so an undramatic relocation gets an honest, non-inflated synthesis rather than being stretched to sound like more than the evidence supports.

fallback._note: Used when the evidence pattern does not clearly match any category below -- should still name what evidence exists rather than defaulting to generic relocation language. This is the file's true safety net; treat a fallback selection as a signal that the category list may need revision, not as a normal, expected outcome.

convergent_place_signature._note: Selection signal: one or more bodies appear in BOTH relocated_angle_contacts AND planet_house_changes (house_changed: true) -- the exact 'repeated body' promotion evidence_ranking already applies when building primary_evidence (see engine/location_services.py's _evidence_ranking: a house change is promoted to primary specifically when its body also has an angle contact). This is the strongest, least ambiguous synthesis case -- multiple independent evidence TYPES (angularity AND house placement) agree on the same function. Direct analog to forecast_synthesis_blocks.json's 'convergent' label ('multiple signals point toward the same lived theme... a pattern gaining enough weight to become recognizable'), adapted from time-repetition to place-repetition. This should be the report's lead paragraph when it applies -- name the specific body and both evidence types, not just 'the evidence agrees.'

angle_led_signature._note: Selection signal: evidence_ranking.primary_evidence is dominated by angle_contact: entries (one or more tight/moderate relocated_angle_contacts), without a matching house-change pattern for the same bodies. Read as: the place foregrounds this function primarily through immediate angularity (Ascendant/Midheaven/Descendant/Imum_Coeli proximity) rather than through a change in life arena. Should name which angle is doing the work (Ascendant = arrival/embodiment, Midheaven = visibility/public role, Descendant = encounter/partnership, Imum_Coeli = privacy/home -- see EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md 'Relocated Angles') since the angle itself carries most of the meaning in this category, more than the specific body does.

house_shift_led_signature._note: Selection signal: evidence_ranking.primary_evidence is dominated by house_change: entries (especially movement_type newly_angular), without a matching angle-contact pattern for the same bodies. Read as: the place foregrounds this function primarily by moving it into a different (often more angular) life arena, not by bringing it into tight orb of a specific angle. Should distinguish newly_angular (a function becoming structurally central that was not natal-angular -- see natal_modifiers[body].was_natal_angular) from a body that was already natal-angular and stays angular after a house_changed transition (repeated centrality, different flavor of emphasis than a genuinely new one).

repeated_body_signature._note: Selection signal: narrower than convergent_place_signature -- select this specifically when ONE body clearly reads as the throughline of the whole report (strong natal_modifiers[body].condition_classification, was_natal_angular true, present in both relocated_angle_contacts and planet_house_changes, and/or appearing as primary evidence for the strongest angle AND the strongest house shift at once). Use when the synthesis job is naming a single planet as the place's core material, distinct from convergent_place_signature's broader 'multiple evidence types agree' framing -- this category is about WHICH planet, convergent is about HOW MANY ways the evidence agrees. A report could select both, in sequence: convergent_place_signature to establish that the evidence agrees, repeated_body_signature to name which planet it agrees about.

quiet_continuity_signature._note: Selection signal: planet_house_changes is mostly or entirely same_house (low or zero changed_house_count), but relocated_angle_contacts may still be present and non-empty -- see LOCATION_EVIDENCE_RECORD_SAMPLES.md Sample B, a real generated example with 0/14 houses changed and 5 angle contacts still present. PROSE_PURPOSE_REVIEW.md is explicit: 'same_house should not be treated as empty.' This category exists so a same-place, nearby, or otherwise low-structural-change relocation gets an honest synthesis that names what DOES persist (angle contacts, natal condition) rather than being padded into a dramatic story it does not support, or dismissed as having 'no evidence.' Should read as continuity and steadiness, not as a null result.

mixed_public_private_signature._note: TAXONOMY NOT IMPLEMENTED (full version): the true house-domain 4-bucket taxonomy (moves_public / moves_private / moves_relational / moves_operational) that BLOCK_SCHEMA.md Block Family 3 defers is NOT built and this leaf does not require it. A NARROWER, already-computable version of this category can be scaffolded today using only the ANGLE names already present in relocated_angle_contacts: Midheaven and Ascendant read as more public/embodied (see EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md's Midheaven='public role, visibility... how the person becomes legible in the outer world' and Ascendant='how the person enters the place'), while Imum_Coeli and Descendant read as more private/relational (Imum_Coeli='home, privacy, roots... underneath the visible life'; Descendant='what arrives through encounter'). Select this category when primary_evidence contains angle contacts on BOTH sides of that split (e.g. a tight Midheaven contact AND a tight Imum_Coeli contact) -- a genuine cross-current between visibility and privacy, not a taxonomy classification of houses. Model the prose on EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md's own worked conflict example: 'The relocated MC suggests public visibility, while the relocated IC/Moon signature asks for privacy and recovery. This does not make the place wrong... it means the location may ask you to build a more honest boundary between public contribution and private restoration.' Do not treat this as a failure state or force resolution -- name both sides.

purpose_aligned_signature._note: Selection signal: purpose_lens is set AND the strongest primary_evidence lines up with what EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md's 'Purpose Lens Modifiers' section prioritizes for that lens (e.g. purpose_lens='career' plus a Midheaven angle contact or a newly_angular 10th-house shift in primary_evidence; purpose_lens='partnership' plus a Descendant contact or 7th-house shift; see that section's full per-lens priority lists for career/belonging/rest/partnership/creative_visibility/study/retreat). This cross-reference (lens -> prioritized angles/houses/planets) is NOT implemented in the engine's evidence_ranking (Round 2 deliberately deferred purpose-lens-aware evidence reweighting -- see LOCATION_EVIDENCE_RECORD_CONTRACT.md's scope note) -- this is a selector-side lookup against the already-authored priority lists in EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md, not a missing engine field. Should name the specific lens and the specific evidence that supports it, and end with that lens's own 'Avoid' guidance from EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md (e.g. career: 'Avoid promising success, fame, clients, or income').

purpose_tradeoff_signature._note: Selection signal: purpose_lens is set BUT the strongest primary_evidence does NOT line up with (or actively cuts against) what that lens prioritizes -- e.g. purpose_lens='rest' or 'retreat' while primary_evidence is dominated by a tight Midheaven contact and a newly_angular 10th-house shift (strong public-visibility evidence). Same selector-side lens-priority lookup dependency as purpose_aligned_signature above -- this is the same deferred cross-reference work, applied to the mismatch case rather than the match case, not a different or additional taxonomy gap. Model on EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md's own worked example: 'For rest, the same emphasis may feel too exposed unless the person has clear boundaries around public demand.' Should name the tradeoff plainly -- what the evidence foregrounds vs. what the person said they wanted -- without implying the place is wrong for that purpose; frame as something to plan around, not avoid.

low_signal_signature._note: Selection signal: evidence_ranking.primary_evidence is empty or very small, changed_house_count is low, relocated_angle_contacts is empty or wide-only, AND/OR birth_context.birth_time_confidence is not exact_birth_time (reducing how much angle/house evidence can be claimed confidently at all -- see evidence_ranking.confidence_notes, which is non-empty exactly in this situation). Maps directly to EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md's 'Minimum Evidence For A Strong Claim' section: 'Use softer language when: Evidence is house-only. Birth time is approximate. Multiple signals conflict. The backend only provides scaffold fields.' This is a legitimate, honest synthesis outcome, not a failure of the destination or the chart -- some relocations genuinely produce thin structural evidence, and an unknown/approximate birth time genuinely limits what angle-based evidence can support. Should be the shortest, plainest category of the nine; resist the temptation to manufacture emphasis that is not there.
